negative_reviews.author: Mohammed Rahman
negative_reviews.text:
First time visiting with my siblings, we brought in drinks from outside, as we didn’t see the sign on the outside saying no drinks from outside. We were told this by the staff which we understood, we put the drinks away after being told and didn’t bring them out after. However if you are going to impose this rule then at least bring out the water we requested when we ordered the meal. All our food came out but the water didn’t. Lacking in customer servicing when you were happy to tell us to put the drinks away but we’re not providing us water when asked during order taking.

Nonetheless the food was good the sushi was nice and the beef ramen was good, the chicken however was bland. Looking at other reviews, I can see people had similar issues.

Atmosphere is nice and calm, chill and the decor is beautiful, especially the post stick note wall.
